summary: Frontend-only testing of the new /campaign and /landing-builder mockup pages, plus stepper/journey regression on /brand-kit, /launch-kit and /ship. All flows verified end-to-end via Playwright at 1440px and 390px. Zero console / page errors observed.
verified_features: /campaign renders campaign-page testid, FlowNav (flow-logo present), 8-step stepper with Campaign active (red) + 5 prior done (green), and footer. No console errors.
/landing-builder renders landing-gen-page testid, Landing active + 6 prior done. No console errors.
Stepper regression: /brand-kit -> Brand active + 3 done; /launch-kit -> Launch active + 4 done; /ship -> Ship active + 7 done.
FlowNav tabs map: flownav-home/brand/launch/campaign/landing/ship -> /, /brand-kit, /launch-kit, /campaign, /landing-builder, /ship (all 6 tabs verified in DOM with correct hrefs).
Flow CTA chain verified by href: launch-to-campaign-cta=/campaign, campaign-to-landing-cta=/landing-builder, landing-to-ship-cta=/ship.

Campaign §01: 4 channel cards (LinkedIn, X / Twitter, Reddit, Email). §02: 10 calendar post cards in horizontal scroller. §03: 10 ready-to-post cards each with copy-campaign-0..9 + autopost-0..9 testids — autopost-0 click triggered sonner toast (1 visible). §04: connect-linkedin / connect-x / connect-reddit / connect-email present; connect-linkedin click triggered toast (2nd toast visible).
CopyButton: copy-campaign-0 click correctly flips to 'COPIED' (uppercase via class as expected).

Landing builder archetypes: archetype-brutalist default selected (bg-black active state). Clicking archetype-minimal and archetype-editorial updates iframe srcDoc AND the visible <pre> code block. Brutalist srcDoc contains #ff3b30; minimal contains #2563eb; editorial contains #6B1F2A. Iframe actually renders generated HTML — iframe h1 reads 'STOP DRAFTING FROM SCRATCH.' and 'MINUTA' brand string is present.
Export tabs: export-tab-html (no <ol>, shows .html blurb), export-tab-wordpress (3 numbered steps), export-tab-shopify (3 numbered steps). copy-landing-html click flips to 'COPIED' without error.
Ship journey recap: 8 rows present — journey-validate, debate, results, brand, launch, campaign, landing, ship.

Responsive: at 1440px and 390px, scrollWidth == innerWidth on both /campaign and /landing-builder (no horizontal page overflow). Calendar scrolls internally (overflow-x-auto on inner container); iframe height-capped at 600px and code block at max-h-72 with overflow-auto.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Ship.jsx hero subtitle still reads 'Stage 06 / Ship' — should be Stage 08 now that the flow has 8 stages. Cosmetic copy issue only (not blocking).

Minor: Campaign.jsx hero reads 'Stage 06 / Marketing Campaign' and LandingGen.jsx reads 'Stage 07 / Landing Page' — these are consistent with the new 8-step order; just flagging the Ship one as the outlier.

Code quality: buildLandingHTML uses new Date().getFullYear() inside a srcDoc string — fine for a mock, but it re-builds the full HTML on every archetype change via useMemo (correctly memoized). No issue.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth in the app
seed_data_creation: none — all content is static mock from /lib/flowData.js and /lib/landingHtml.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_3 covered the two new mockup pages /campaign and /landing-builder plus regression on the 8-step stepper across /brand-kit, /launch-kit, /ship. CopyButton renders 'Copied' as 'COPIED' due to the uppercase class — use case-insensitive or uppercase assertions. Sonner toast selector is [data-sonner-toast]. The landing-preview is an <iframe srcDoc>, not a screenshot — use page.frame_locator('[data-testid="landing-preview"]') to assert against rendered HTML. Note an existing copy typo in Ship.jsx hero ('Stage 06 / Ship') that doesn't affect functionality.
